versions.changes: Update from GitHub: the Update page shows the installed version and the newest published version, lists every version in the public releases repository (DarrenS01/InvestTrackerApp_public) and lets you choose any of them, including an older one. You confirm first; your data is backed up, the file is downloaded and checked against its SHA-256, then installed and the program restarts. The packaged program takes the ready-made InvestTracker.exe when one is published (no Python needed) and otherwise builds from the source zip as before. A GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) builds the Windows exe and publishes it with the source zip and index.json whenever tracker/version.py changes on main (needs the PUBLIC_REPO_TOKEN secret). Choosing a file on the Update page still works.
